name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you face a trial of the Light. The Symbol of Life lets you restore a fallen ally.
As a dwarf, you face the Dark Iron dwarves entrenched south of Helm's Bed Lake in Dun Morogh.
As an Alliance member, you help protect dwarven scouts and keep sacred scripts from the Dark Iron dwarves.

aliases: what is the tome of divinity
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity tests a young paladin's devotion and worthiness. An initiate receives the Symbol of Life and is sent to save a fallen scout, calling on the Light to bring someone back from death.
faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?

faq.answer: Narm Faulk is an Alliance scout ambushed by Dark Iron dwarves south of Helm's Bed Lake. He gave up his chance to flee so his partner Muiredon could escape, and fell in battle before the Light restored him.
Muiredon is the scout who fled the Dark Iron ambush at Narm Faulk's urging. He returns for reinforcements and directs the paladin to save his fallen comrade with the Symbol of Life.

aliases: what is the symbol of life
faq.answer: Tiza and Muiredon bestow the Symbol of Life upon the paladin with instructions. This sacred relic can resurrect the dead when a worthy servant of the Light channels its power.
faq.q: What is the Symbol of Life?

aliases: what were they doing south of helms bed lake
faq.answer: Muiredon and Narm Faulk were spying on Dark Iron dwarves entrenched south of Helm's Bed Lake. They saw an enemy leader issuing orders and tried to recover sacred scripts before the dwarves overwhelmed them.
faq.q: What were Narm and Muiredon doing near Helm's Bed Lake?

faq.answer: Tiza helps dispatch aid and prepares the Symbol of Life with Muiredon for the rescue.

sections.body: South of Helm's Bed Lake, dwarven scouts Muiredon and Narm Faulk watched Dark Iron dwarves entrench themselves. When they saw an enemy commander issuing orders, they struck at several foes and tried to secure a script. The Dark Irons overwhelmed them with unexpected ferocity. Muiredon fled for reinforcements while Narm held the line.
sections.title: Ambush at the Lake

sections.body: With the Symbol of Life, a paladin initiate searches Dun Morogh's snowy reaches for Narm Faulk. Narm fell beneath the Dark Iron assault, but the holy relic draws his spirit back just as the Light was ready to embrace him fully. In that moment, the initiate answers the first call of a paladin: restoring life to the fallen.
sections.title: A Test of Faith

summary: A paladin initiate carries the Symbol of Life to the frigid shores south of Helm's Bed Lake in Dun Morogh. There, the initiate must find Narm Faulk, a brave scout who fell holding off Dark Iron dwarves, and call him back with the Light.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
